evidence.reason: The stale SUMS entry is a fabricated "2"*64 digest, while the downloaded bytes are b"unexpected"; that digest matches neither the stale nor the refreshed digest. So fetch_image raises ValueError whether it verifies against the stale manifest or the refreshed one, and the test still passes if the implementation checks the wrong manifest. Writing sha256_bytes(b"unexpected") into the stale manifest and keeping the refreshed digest different makes only the refreshed-manifest check fail.
